economy.summary: Her campaign platform proposes expanding childcare assistance and property tax rebate programs and funding affordable housing construction and rental support, saying working families should be able to keep more money for savings, stability, and a better quality of life.
economy.short: Proposes childcare assistance, property tax rebates, affordable housing funding.

taxes.summary: Her platform proposes closing tax loopholes for the ultra-wealthy and ensuring top earners pay what she calls their fair share, saying working families currently contribute most to state budgets.
taxes.short: Proposes closing tax loopholes; says top earners should pay more.

education.summary: A former York City schools teacher, she proposes fully and fairly funding public education, strengthening support for teachers and school staff, reforming charter school funding for transparency and accountability, and funding school counselors, social workers, and mental health services.
education.short: Proposes fully funding public schools, charter funding reform, counselors.

energy.summary: Under a responsible growth and infrastructure plank, she opposes letting data centers pass infrastructure costs on to residential ratepayers and supports water conservation plans and energy-use reporting requirements.
energy.short: Opposes data-center costs on ratepayers; supports conservation, energy reporting.

guns.summary: Her school platform includes funding building safety improvements and violence prevention programs in schools; her site does not detail a broader gun policy.
guns.short: Supports school safety improvements, violence prevention; no broader gun policy.

economy.summary: His campaign site calls for ending what he describes as job-killing regulations to foster business growth, reducing government involvement in personal and professional lives, and enacting tort reform to protect companies from what he calls frivolous lawsuits.
economy.short: Calls for cutting regulations, downsizing government, enacting tort reform.

taxes.summary: Calls Pennsylvania's school property tax system outdated and oppressive to homeowners, particularly low- and middle-income families, and supports eliminating it; pledges to cut excess spending and restore fiscal discipline.
taxes.short: Supports eliminating school property taxes; pledges to cut spending.

abortion.summary: His campaign site pledges to protect what it calls the right to life from conception to death and to support pro-life policies.
abortion.short: Pledges to protect life from conception; supports pro-life policies.

education.summary: Supports parental school choice with tax dollars following the student to the school a family chooses, and calls for increased investment in high school and trade-school vocational programs to address workforce skill gaps.
education.short: Supports school choice, dollars following students, vocational program investment.

healthcare.summary: His campaign site commits to combating Pennsylvania's opioid epidemic through collaboration with law enforcement, medical professionals, and recovery specialists; the site does not detail a broader healthcare platform.
healthcare.short: Commits to fighting opioid epidemic; no broader healthcare platform.
